title: Catalogue
slide_intent: Preserve instant recognition in a small product tile. A visible contact shadow lets a viewer perceive the object’s shape and position.
strategic_value: Instacart can keep grocery listings clear while retaining some of the dimension found in its editorial photography.
demonstration: Produce, bottles and a spice jar stand against pale fields. The photograph of bananas, tomatoes and leafy greens occupies the largest tile.
practical_value: Use a plain ground and check that the product casts a grounding shadow before reducing the photograph to catalog size.

content_islands.name: Catalog brief
content_islands.spec: Explain small-space recognition and grounding shadows on the dark green panel. Stack the four selection terms near its lower edge.

content_islands.name: Catalog specimens
content_islands.spec: Arrange the clean product photographs in adjoining rectangles. Give the produce group enough room to show overlap and use tighter panels for individual bottles and the spice jar.
